title: The transversal achievement game on a square grid
summary: In the transversal achievement game on the $n\times n$ board, two players alternately claim cells, and the first to own a transversal---a set of $n$ cells of which no two share a row or column---wins. Ranđelović showed that the first player wins for every $n\ge4$, while the game is a draw for $n=2,3$. We give an independent proof that the first player wins for $n\ge4$ that additionally establishes a bound on the length of the win: the given strategy forces a win by ply $2n+3$, i.e.\ on the first player's $(n+2)$-nd move, for every $n\ge4$.
